From: Ines Duarte <iduarte@crestlinelog.com>
To: Priya Raman <praman@crestlinelog.com>
Subject: Postmortem: routing engine outage, Sept 21

Priya,

Summary: The routing engine was down for 2 hours 12 minutes on Sept 21. Root cause was a certificate that expired on the internal load balancer at 10.42.8.15. About 1,900 routes were planned manually.

Fixes:
1. Automated certificate renewal (done)
2. Expiry alerts 30 days out (done)
3. Failover to the secondary region (Q4)

Ines
